guidelines.detail: same as LRN-063 (The description specifies repeating training and checking until the time goal is met, then proceeding. The validator identifies a deadlocking parallel gateway, supporting a control-flow modeling error rather than a missing activity. Learned guideline LRN-063 already states the same modeling rule.)

same as LRN-026 (The description specifies ordered, conditional, and concurrent work, while the records identify omitted sequence flows between modeled elements. LRN-026 already states essentially the same control-flow guidance.)

same as LRN-020 (The description supports the extra qualifiers in the generated labels: it specifies going from home, drinking while running, and measuring time after a 5 km run. These records support preserving meaningful stated distinctions in labels, which is already captured by LRN-020.)

refines FID-01 (The description explicitly includes measuring the time as well as running 5 km, and the reference has a separate measurement activity that the generated model lacks. FID-01 already requires modeling every distinct activity; this guideline clarifies that requirement for a stated measurement. No extra_element record was provided indicating the measurement was modeled under another element type.)

same as LRN-025 (The generated labels add contextual details that the reference labels omit. LRN-025 already advises omitting contextual or explanatory details that are not needed to distinguish an activity, while preserving essential meaning.)

same as LRN-010 (The description explicitly says running and drinking happen at the same time, and identifies running and time measurement as distinct activities. The missing records show the activities and their parallel structure were not modeled; LRN-010 already gives essentially the same guidance for required activities before later work.)

same as LRN-025 (P2 and P3 show labels adding context to actions whose surrounding process already supplies that context. This matches LRN-025. P1 is not cited: its reference label reverses the direction stated in the description, so it does not support copying that label.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says an activity is repeated until a stated condition is met: Model each attempt followed by a decision; loop back to repeat the activity when the condition is not met, and continue when it is met.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says an activity or sequence of activities must be repeated until a stated condition is met

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states a sequence of activities or a conditional step followed by a later activity: Connect the activities and any modeled gateways in the stated order with sequence flows, including every described transition.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states an order between activities or gateways, including transitions into or out of a conditional branch or a repeated step

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description distinguishes an event or activity by its action, actor, object, recipient, or another meaningful qualifier: Label each BPMN element so that it preserves those stated details without substituting a broader or different meaning.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description distinguishes an activity from similar activities by a stated action, object, or other meaningful qualifier

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states an activity and separately states that its duration or performance is measured: Model the measurement as a distinct activity, and connect it to the measured activity according to the temporal relationship stated in the description.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states an activity and separately states that its duration or performance is measured

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description gives an activity together with contextual or explanatory details that are not needed to distinguish the activity in its process context: Label the BPMN task with its core action and necessary object, omitting redundant contextual modifiers while preserving details essential to the activity’s meaning.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description gives an activity together with contextual details that are redundant for identifying the activity in its process context

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that several activities are all required before a later activity or outcome: Model the activities as parallel branches and synchronize all branches with a parallel gateway before the later activity or outcome.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description explicitly states that two or more distinct activities happen at the same time
